title: oncidium umbrosum
intro: Oncidium umbrosum, commonly known as the Orchid of the Poor, is a species of orchid native to Central and South America. This plant is renowned for its medicinal properties and has been traditionally used in folk medicine for various health benefits, including the treatment of respiratory issues, fever, and digestive problems. The health benefits of Oncidium umbrosum are attributed to its therapeutic actions, such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which are said to promote healing and protection against oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of Oncidium umbrosum include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
